queue.hypothesis: Adding cross-attention memory module as alternative to GDN will enable content-based retrieval without increasing state_size beyond 32 by using external memory bank
queue.rationale: Cross-attention provides content-addressable memory retrieval that avoids GDN's sequential state update bottlenecks, addressing the precision and capacity issues while staying within state_size constraints.
queue.instruction: In huggingface_rmm_v5.py, add a cross-attention memory module that replaces GatedDeltaNet. Create a learnable memory bank of size state_size=32 with embedding dimension n_embd=128, and implement cross-attention queries from input tokens to retrieve from this memory bank.
